title: @object-ui/runner: has no tsconfig at all, and imports two exports `@object-ui/core` does not have
body:
Found by the full type-check sweep in #2911 / #2915. `@object-ui/runner` is the **worst-covered package in the repo**: `build` is `vite build` (transpile only), it has **no `type-check` script**, and — uniquely — **no `tsconfig.json` at all**. Nothing has ever type-checked it.

It is a published package (`private: false`, v16.1.0).

## The likely-real bug

```
packages/runner/src/lib/mockDataSource.ts(9,15): error TS2724:
  '"@object-ui/core"' has no exported member named 'DataSource'. Did you mean 'ApiDataSource'?
packages/runner/src/lib/mockDataSource.ts(9,27): error TS2724:
  '"@object-ui/core"' has no exported member named 'BatchTransactionOperation'. Did you mean 'TransactionOperation'?
packages/runner/src/lib/mockDataSource.ts(47,36): error TS2345:
  Argument of type 'this' is not assignable to parameter of type 'DataSource<any>'.
```

Two imported names do not exist on `@object-ui/core`. If they are value imports rather than type-only, this throws at runtime; if type-only, the `DataSource` contract `mockDataSource` claims to implement is unenforced, which is consistent with the `TS2345` on line 47. **Worth checking whether the runner actually works** — `DataSource` is plausibly a rename of `ApiDataSource` and `BatchTransactionOperation` of `TransactionOperation`, but that should be confirmed against `@object-ui/core`'s current exports rather than assumed.

## The rest (14 total)

Config-shaped, all from having no tsconfig — they need `vite/client` types and `allowImportingTsExtensions`, not source changes:

```
src/lib/MetadataLoader.ts(21,33) TS2339: Property 'glob' does not exist on type 'ImportMeta'.   (x3)
src/main.tsx(11,17) TS5097: An import path can only end with a '.tsx' extension when
  'allowImportingTsExtensions' is enabled.
src/main.tsx(12,8) TS2882: Cannot find module or type declarations for side-effect
  import of './index.css'.
src/lib/mockDataSource.ts TS6133: 'resource' / 'id' declared but never read   (x6)
```

## Suggested order

1. Author `packages/runner/tsconfig.json` mirroring a type-checked peer (e.g. `packages/plugin-list`), including the `paths` override — without it you get ~104 spurious TS6059 `rootDir` errors, and because `runner` has no tsconfig, bare `tsc` walks up to the **root** config and type-checks the entire monorepo. See #2915.
2. Add `vite/client` types + `allowImportingTsExtensions` to clear the config-shaped errors.
3. Resolve the two missing `@object-ui/core` imports — the actual bug.
4. Add `"type-check": "tsc --noEmit"` and **delete the `DEBT` entry** in `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` (currently `errors: 14`); the guard fails if the entry outlives the gap.

Refs #2911, #2915
